posts.title: There Aren’t Really 30 Million Vegetarians in Brazil
posts.description: Someone is wrong on the internet I often compete with my family for the highest score in various daily geography quiz games. I recently took second place to my brother in one game by giving what was apparently a massive underestimate for how many people in Brazil are vegetarian. posts.title: Posting randomly selected satellite imagery chunks from my home state
posts.description: What Last month, I made a Twitter bot using RStudio.
